data.name: Rideshare "Stimulator"
data.detailed_description:
Rideshare "Stimulator" is an immersive driving simulation game that puts you behind the wheel as a rideshare business owner. Dodge traffic, follow the rules, and race the clock to drop off your quirky passengers, each with a story that's either captivating, hilarious, or just plain weird.

Because you never know who you’re going to pick up next…

  • Expand Your Rideshare Business: Your driving style and the condition of your vehicle directly influence how passengers react, affecting your overall rating, reviews, and tips.

  • Have Stimulating Conversations: Each ride presents players with unique and unpredictable passenger stories, ensuring a diverse and engaging gameplay experience.

  • Dodge Real-world Traffic & Pedestrians: The city comes to life with dynamic real-world traffic. Wait for traffic lights, yield to pedestrians, and navigate the intricacies of a well-regulated traffic system.

  • Experience a Living, Breathing City: A visually stunning game world, crafted to offer immersive environments. Cruise through streets inspired by both European and American cities, each with its unique charm and beauty

  • Master Intuitive Car Controls: The game provides intuitive and accessible car controls, designed to offer an enjoyable driving experience for all players.

  • Maintain Your Vehicle: Between rides, keep the car clean, fix what needs fixing, and make sure it’s ready for whoever gets in next.

data.short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (4C/8T) / Intel Core i5-8400 (6C/6T)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB VRAM, NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-12600KF (6С/12T @ 3700 + 4С/4T @ 2800) / AMD Ryzen 7 5800 (8C/16T @ 3400)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM, NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
